name: Bart De Wever
role: Prime Minister of Belgium (Eerste minister / Premier ministre)
party: Nieuw-Vlaamse Alliantie (N-VA) — European Conservatives and Reformists (ECR) in the European Parliament
bio: Bart De Wever, born in Mortsel on 21 December 1970 and a history graduate of KU Leuven, has been Prime Minister of Belgium since 3 February 2025, the first Flemish nationalist to hold the office. A former Volksunie member, he co-founded the New Flemish Alliance (N-VA) after that party split in 2001 and chaired it from 2004 until he became Prime Minister, leading it to first place in Flanders at every federal election from 2010 to 2024. He was Mayor of Antwerp from 1 January 2013 until 3 February 2025 (he remains titular mayor while in federal office) and sat at various times in the Flemish Parliament, the Chamber of Representatives and the Senate. After the June 2024 elections he spent almost eight months as formateur before forming the five-party 'Arizona' coalition of N-VA, MR, Les Engagés, Vooruit and CD&V, whose programme centres on budget consolidation, labour-market, pension and tax reforms and a stricter migration policy. As of October 2026 his government holds full powers but has been deadlocked for months over the 2027–2029 budget, after a similar impasse in autumn 2025.
